text:
Avery Chen: Heads up — ARB next week needs a quick lead swap. I'm OOO Thu-Fri so can't facilitate the Tue session. Can someone pick up facilitation for the next two meetings? Also proposing a slim agenda so we can keep it under 50m.

Avery Chen: Proposed agenda: 1) RFC #421 (kv-cache eviction policy) — 10m, 2) Batching/qp optimization design quick review — 15m, 3) Perf regressions triage (two highest-pri issues) — 20m, 4) Rollouts & ops notes — 5m. Say if you want to present or need more time.

Priya Kapoor: I can facilitate Tue if no objections. I'll do a 2min kickoff and keep time. @Samir Patel can you commit to presenting RFC #421? :alarm_clock:

Samir Patel: Yep I can run the RFC. I'll aim for 8–10 min + 2m for q's. I also want to request 3 extra mins for one slide on workload assumptions.

Jules Martin: Quick note — can we nudge start to 11:00 PT? Two infra folks have a conflict at 9:30. 11:00 would make it easier for EU folks too.

Rina Gomez: 11:00 PT works for me. +1 for trimming the batching review to focus on perf tradeoffs.

Priya Kapoor: 11:00 OK, I'll update the agenda: make batching review 12m focused on tradeoffs, leave triage at 20. Also volunteering to surface the two triage tickets (perf-127, perf-130).

Avery Chen: Thanks — looks good. Can someone add the RFC and the two perf tickets to the calendar invite and attach the short slide deck? If not, @Priya you're fine to add?

Priya Kapoor: I got it, will attach RFC link + two perf ticket links. Also adding a tiny pre-read: one-paragraph summary of kv-cache change.

Samir Patel: For the RFC pre-read: adding a one-paragraph summary in thread and a short diff snippet. Putting it in the doc now.

calendar-bot: Proposed event updated: "ARB — Tue 11:00 PT (facilitator: Priya Kapoor)". Invitees: eng-platform, eng-runtime, eng-ml. Agenda attached.

Jules Martin: One last ask — can we reserve a 10m follow-up slot next week for action items/rollout sign-off if we need it? If not, we'll do async.

Avery Chen: Good call. Let's tentatively block Wed 10:00 PT for a short follow-up; I'll mark it tentative on the invite. If unused, I'll remove it after the meeting. :white_check_mark:
